title_zh: 关于已满十二周岁不满十四周岁未成年人严重暴力犯罪，两部门出新规
title_en: Two Departments Issue New Rules on Serious Violent Crimes by Minors Aged 12-14
summary_zh: 7月31日，两部门出台新规，对已满十二周岁不满十四周岁未成年人严重暴力犯罪案件的法律适用和办理程序作出明确规定。
summary_en: On July 31, two departments issued new rules specifying legal application and procedures for handling serious violent crimes committed by minors aged 12-14.
